_comment: session-launch-check.py の起動の見張り (--wait-first-turn)・set の後の 1 行・Stop の記録の foil の歯 (修正の一部を外した mutant で、 その部分を見る check だけが落ちるか)、 worker の窓の Stop (起こした session へ 1 行) と card の台帳。

mutants.name: 見張りが claim (go を待たずに仕事に入った) を見ない
expect_fail: watch: the worker claimed
expect_pass: watch: the first turn ended and the record matches
hook-stop: a watch is running

mutants.name: 見張りが走っているのを読まない
pairs: return any("session-launch-check.py" in ln and WATCH_FLAG in ln and local_id in ln for ln in ps.splitlines())
expect_fail: post-set: the watch is already running
hook-stop: a watch is running
expect_pass: post-set: a worker that waits for go and no watch

mutants.name: 最初の turn が始まったか (起動の後の応答) を見ない
pairs:
if not any(r and cw._epoch(r) > since for r in ev["replies"]):
        return False, "最初の turn がまだ始まっていない"
expect_fail: watch: just created, idle in the live list
watch: the same, not in the live list yet
expect_pass: watch: the first turn ended and the record matches
watch: a session that is nowhere

mutants.name: app の記録にも一覧にも無い子の猶予を外す
pairs: if time.time() - start >= grace and not ds.find(local):
expect_fail: within the grace → keeps waiting
expect_pass: watch: a session that is nowhere

mutants.name: model と effort を続けて直したときの 2 回目の抑止を外す
expect_fail: post-set: the effort setter right after the model setter
expect_pass: post-set: a worker started as asked

mutants.name: claim した worker に掲示板の request の detach を言わない
pairs: if hit.get("detach") and not diffs else ""
expect_fail: watch: the worker claimed
expect_pass: post-start: right model and the record asks detach

mutants.name: 起こした直後の文から見張りの 1 行を外す
pairs: f"  直し方: (1) この turn のうちに Bash の run_in_background で `{watch_cmd(local_id, want_m, want_e)}` を出して"
expect_fail: post-start: capped → the background watch line comes first
post-start: a model mismatch → the watch first
expect_pass: post-start: capped model and effort → advice with both setters

mutants.name: Stop の記録を worker ごとに 1 回にしない
expect_fail: hook-stop: the same worker and asked values
expect_pass: hook-stop block: a decision with the watch line

mutants.name: worker の窓の Stop が起こした session への SendMessage を見ない
expect_fail: worker stop: the line was sent to the starter
expect_pass: worker stop: record differs, nothing sent to the starter

mutants.name: worker の窓の Stop が claim を見ない
pairs: if me.get("stop_noted") == key or claimed_after(path, 0) or
expect_fail: worker stop: the worker claimed
expect_pass: worker stop: record differs, nothing sent to the starter

mutants.name: worker の窓の Stop を 1 回にしない
expect_fail: worker stop: once per window
expect_pass: worker stop: record differs, nothing sent to the starter

mutants.name: card の頼んだ値を台帳に残さない
expect_fail: post-start card: the asked model and effort are in the ledger
post-start by proposal_id: the card's asked values are used
expect_pass: post-start card above the launcher

mutants.name: proposal_id で起こしたときに card の台帳を引かない
pairs: if ti.get("proposal_id") and not (want_m or want_e or reason):
expect_fail: post-start by proposal_id: the card's asked values are used
expect_pass: post-start card: the asked model and effort are in the ledger

mutants.name: 依頼元と同じ値の card にも知らせる
expect_fail: post-start card at the launcher's own values
expect_pass: post-start card above the launcher

mutants.name: detach の知らせを本人が worker の窓で答える向きに戻す
pairs:
子の turn の終わりの知らせを依頼元に来させない"
            f" (判断の問いは子が掲示板の note か SendMessage で依頼元に出す。

子の turn の終わりの知らせと本人への問いを"
            f"依頼元に来させない (本人は worker の窓で答える。
expect_fail: post-start: the detach note sends the child's questions of judgment to the requester
expect_pass: post-start: right model and the record asks detach → detach_session note

mutants.name: worker でない起動の署名を見ない
expect_fail: a hand-off with a not-worker signature (re:) → pass
a literal not-worker signature → pass
expect_pass: signatures present, a hand-off without one → still blocked
a signature does not pass a hand-off that names a board request with no launch record
no signature file → a coordinator's hand-off is blocked as before

mutants.name: 署名の re: の行を literal として読む
expect_fail: a hand-off with a not-worker signature (re:) → pass
expect_pass: a literal not-worker signature → pass
signatures present, a hand-off without one → still blocked
